title: Example Complications Addon: Allergic
description: A datapack for Complications that adds a new predicate (on grass) and a Complication that makes use of it.
body: An add-on datapack for Complications that adds a new predicate (on grass) and a new Complication (Allergic) that makes use of it - poisoned while touching grass, regenerating otherwise. Use it as an example of how to make your own Complications!
